item.title: Four tornadoes confirmed in Lincoln, Lawrence counties

item.title: 14-year-old killed in McComb shooting
item.description: MCCOMB, Miss. (WJTV) - A 14-year-old was killed during a shooting in McComb. According to the Pike County coroner, the shooting occurred on Avenue B before 1:45 p.m. on February 15, 2026. item.title: Yazoo City's main fire station collapses, no injuries
item.description: YAZOO CITY, Miss. (WJTV) - Yazoo City's main fire station collapsed this weekend. The Yazoo Herald reported the incident happened at the historic building on Washington Street on February 14, 2026. According to Yazoo City police, no one was inside the building when it collapsed.

item.title: 2 killed, 3 injured in Rhode Island ice rink shooting
item.description: Three people are dead, including the suspect, and three others are in critical condition after a shooting at a Rhode Island ice skating rink Monday afternoon.

item.title: 1 officer killed, 2nd injured in shooting near Indiana high school; suspect apprehended
item.description: One police officer was killed and another was injured in a shooting in Beech Grove, Indiana on Monday. The suspect was taken into custody Monday evening, according to the Indianapolis Metropolitan Police Department.
